datasets.name: kpi_summary
queryLines:
WITH all_eps AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT served_entity_id, endpoint_name, entity_name
  FROM system.serving.served_entities
  WHERE workspace_id = '<YOUR_WORKSPACE_ID>'
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT
    eu.served_entity_id,
    eu.status_code,
    eu.request_time,
    coalesce(ep.endpoint_name, '?') AS endpoint_name,
    CASE
      WHEN ep.entity_name LIKE '<YOUR_CATALOG>.model_workbench.%' THEN 'custom'
      WHEN element_at(eu.usage_context, 'app') = 'model-workbench' THEN 'fmapi'
      ELSE NULL
    END AS source
  FROM system.serving.endpoint_usage eu
  LEFT JOIN all_eps ep USING (served_entity_id)
  WHERE eu.request_time >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL 7 DAYS
    AND eu.workspace_id = '<YOUR_WORKSPACE_ID>'
)
SELECT
  count(*) AS invocations_7d,
  ROUND(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN status_code >= 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 2) AS error_rate_pct,
  COUNT(DISTINCT endpoint_name) AS endpoints_7d
FROM filtered
WHERE source IS NOT NULL

datasets.name: kpi_cost
datasets.displayName: Last 7 days cost (USD) — custom endpoints only
queryLines:
-- Custom endpoints hosted in our app's UC schema. Cost is direct from billing.usage.
-- FMAPI cost attribution per-app is not in billing.usage; the per-endpoint table
-- below approximates it from token counts × list_prices for the 'fmapi' rows.
SELECT round(sum(u.usage_quantity * coalesce(lp.pricing.default, 0)), 2) AS cost_7d_usd
FROM system.billing.usage u
LEFT JOIN system.billing.list_prices lp
  ON u.sku_name = lp.sku_name AND u.usage_unit = lp.usage_unit
  AND u.usage_start_time >= lp.price_start_time
  AND (lp.price_end_time IS NULL OR u.usage_start_time < lp.price_end_time)
WHERE u.workspace_id = '<YOUR_WORKSPACE_ID>'
  AND u.usage_metadata.endpoint_name IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT endpoint_name
    FROM system.serving.served_entities
    WHERE workspace_id = '<YOUR_WORKSPACE_ID>'
      AND entity_name LIKE '<YOUR_CATALOG>.model_workbench.%'
  )
  AND u.usage_date >= current_date() - 7

datasets.name: usage_daily
queryLines:
WITH all_eps AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT served_entity_id, endpoint_name, entity_name
  FROM system.serving.served_entities
  WHERE workspace_id = '<YOUR_WORKSPACE_ID>'
)
SELECT
  date_trunc('DAY', eu.request_time) AS day,
  ep.endpoint_name,
  count(*) AS invocations
FROM system.serving.endpoint_usage eu
LEFT JOIN all_eps ep USING (served_entity_id)
WHERE eu.request_time >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL 30 DAYS
  AND eu.workspace_id = '<YOUR_WORKSPACE_ID>'
  AND (
    ep.entity_name LIKE '<YOUR_CATALOG>.model_workbench.%'
    OR element_at(eu.usage_context, 'app') = 'model-workbench'
  )
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

datasets.name: cost_daily
datasets.displayName: Daily cost by endpoint (30d, USD) — custom endpoints
queryLines:
SELECT
  u.usage_date AS day,
  u.usage_metadata.endpoint_name AS endpoint_name,
  round(sum(u.usage_quantity * coalesce(lp.pricing.default, 0)), 4) AS cost_usd
FROM system.billing.usage u
LEFT JOIN system.billing.list_prices lp
  ON u.sku_name = lp.sku_name AND u.usage_unit = lp.usage_unit
  AND u.usage_start_time >= lp.price_start_time
  AND (lp.price_end_time IS NULL OR u.usage_start_time < lp.price_end_time)
WHERE u.workspace_id = '<YOUR_WORKSPACE_ID>'
  AND u.usage_metadata.endpoint_name IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT endpoint_name
    FROM system.serving.served_entities
    WHERE workspace_id = '<YOUR_WORKSPACE_ID>'
      AND entity_name LIKE '<YOUR_CATALOG>.model_workbench.%'
  )
  AND u.usage_date >= current_date() - 30
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, cost_usd DESC

datasets.name: endpoint_detail
queryLines:
WITH all_eps AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT served_entity_id, endpoint_name, entity_name
  FROM system.serving.served_entities
  WHERE workspace_id = '<YOUR_WORKSPACE_ID>'
),
u7 AS (
  -- Invocations attributable to this app: custom endpoints in our UC schema,
  -- plus any FMAPI call tagged with usage_context.app = 'model-workbench'.
  SELECT
    coalesce(ep.endpoint_name, '?') AS endpoint_name,
    CASE
      WHEN ep.entity_name LIKE '<YOUR_CATALOG>.model_workbench.%' THEN 'custom'
      ELSE 'fmapi'
    END AS kind,
    count(*) AS invocations_7d,
    sum(CASE WHEN eu.status_code >= 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS errors_7d,
    coalesce(sum(eu.input_token_count), 0) AS input_tokens_7d,
    coalesce(sum(eu.output_token_count), 0) AS output_tokens_7d,
    max(eu.request_time) AS last_call
  FROM system.serving.endpoint_usage eu
  LEFT JOIN all_eps ep USING (served_entity_id)
  WHERE eu.request_time >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL 7 DAYS
    AND eu.workspace_id = '<YOUR_WORKSPACE_ID>'
    AND (
      ep.entity_name LIKE '<YOUR_CATALOG>.model_workbench.%'
      OR element_at(eu.usage_context, 'app') = 'model-workbench'
    )
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
c7 AS (
  -- Cost attribution. For custom endpoints we read billing.usage directly.
  -- For FMAPI we'd need to derive from tokens × list_prices — left null in v1.
  SELECT
    u.usage_metadata.endpoint_name AS endpoint_name,
    round(sum(u.usage_quantity * coalesce(lp.pricing.default, 0)), 4) AS cost_7d_usd
  FROM system.billing.usage u
  LEFT JOIN system.billing.list_prices lp
    ON u.sku_name = lp.sku_name AND u.usage_unit = lp.usage_unit
    AND u.usage_start_time >= lp.price_start_time
    AND (lp.price_end_time IS NULL OR u.usage_start_time < lp.price_end_time)
  WHERE u.workspace_id = '<YOUR_WORKSPACE_ID>'
    AND u.usage_metadata.endpoint_name IN (
      SELECT DISTINCT endpoint_name
      FROM system.serving.served_entities
      WHERE workspace_id = '<YOUR_WORKSPACE_ID>'
        AND entity_name LIKE '<YOUR_CATALOG>.model_workbench.%'
    )
    AND u.usage_date >= current_date() - 7
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  u7.endpoint_name,
  u7.kind,
  u7.invocations_7d,
  coalesce(c7.cost_7d_usd, 0) AS cost_7d_usd,
  u7.errors_7d,
  ROUND(100.0 * u7.errors_7d / NULLIF(u7.invocations_7d, 0), 2) AS error_rate_pct,
  u7.input_tokens_7d + u7.output_tokens_7d AS tokens_7d,
  u7.last_call
FROM u7 LEFT JOIN c7 USING (endpoint_name)
ORDER BY cost_7d_usd DESC NULLS LAST, invocations_7d DESC

lines: Scoped to this app only — custom endpoints in our UC schema plus FMAPI calls tagged with usage_context.app=model-workbench. Cost data delayed up to 24h. FMAPI per-app cost is approximated by tokens × list_prices.
Kind = custom (our GPU endpoints) or fmapi (token-billed Foundation Model APIs). Cost shown for custom endpoints only; for FMAPI, multiply tokens by published per-token rate.
